fields.description: A bin, line or location whose code starts with one of these tokens (the leading letters/digits, e.g. JPR for JPR/KMILL/H2, CCL2 for CCL2 /G18/ 36) belongs to this site. Everything in Bin Inventory, Scan Transactions and the Bin Master is assigned this way. Saving re-classifies the scan ledger in the background.
